summary: PIMCO Asset-Based Lending Co LLC filed an 8-K covering an unregistered sale of equity securities under Item 3.02 and a net asset value update under Item 8.01. The company issued multiple classes of limited liability company interests for cash to third-party investors, with gross proceeds of approximately $67.8 million, including shares issued under a distribution reinvestment plan. The sales were exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D, and Regulation S. The filing also disclosed net asset values per share for two series as of April 30, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising and NAV disclosure, not a special situation.
